decisions: Observe only; no executor, grant issuance or action side effects.
Policy and context are declared simulation inputs, not authenticated authority.
Policy profile ID development-observe and version0.1.0 only; canonical policy hash binds request.
CLI output is minimal fixed labels and digests; input data and exception details never echoed.
Default policy only development inspect/patch/publication; all decisions executable=false.

exit_codes.0: Valid validation or valid observation, including deny and require_review.
exit_codes.2: Invalid arguments, malformed/unavailable inputs, invalid policy/context/request or internal failure.

limitations: No signature authenticity or host identity verification.
No artifact-content inspection, secret scanner, request execution or production enforcement.
Fixed-time fixtures expire outside their test clock.
remaining: Parent integration regression and independent review

Malformed context timestamp/URI and invalid clock cannot echo raw values.
Stronger no-target-read regression and CLI help warning: zero exit is never execution permission.
